title: No Armour
description: A data pack that removes armour and related features
body:
# No Armour
This is a simple datapack I made to prevent players from geting armour to make the game harder.

1. All crafting recipies for armour have been removed
2. Armour has been removed from randomly generated loot
3. Armour trims have been removed from randomly generated loot
4. Enchantments exclusive to armour have been removed from random loot, the enchantment table, and villager trades
5. Upgradeing diamond armour to netherite has been removed
6. Applying Armour trims has been removed
7. The abilty to dye leather armour has been removed



note
this data pack dose NOT complety remove armour from the game
you can still get armour from villager trades & mob drops
